evidence.says: macOS gui::CapabilitiesSystem::Update (bg3_macos_x64+0x2622ED0) walks the accepted WeaponDisarmedNotificationComponents (stride 0x10) and, when Slot (+8) is 3, looks the handle at +0 up in VMGameData's character collection (FindItemInCollection<gui::VMCharacter> by VMGameObject entity) and sets capability modifier 0xB on that VMCharacter: the handle is the character whose weapon was knocked away, not the weapon.

1 byte. bg3.exe+0x2DF53B0 copies the byte at +8 of the message; replication bg3.exe+0x8FB2A0 reads exactly one byte into +8. Default 0x16 - the same default as the Slot byte of esv::disarm::WeaponDisarmedEventOneFrameComponent (+0x18), which holds the weapon's EquipableComponent slot.
tail padding; neither the creator nor replication touches it

survey.live_reason: no live or captured instance: needs a situation that creates it
open_questions: Identity of the entity at +0 (weapon or character): the sender of message kind 0x30 was not found.
survey.second_pass: Offsets and widths are established on Windows: creator bg3.exe+0x2DF1640, notification system bg3.exe+0x2DF53B0 and replication reader bg3.exe+0x8FB2A0 (entity handle at +0, exactly one byte at +8); no game member names exist (no macOS FieldMeta, not saved).
